title: HAL test: NULL assertion gap in identity_get test
description: Line 109 in lichen/tests/hal/src/main.c calls lichen_hal_identity_get(NULL) without asserting expected behavior. The API declares _Nonnull for this parameter. Either the test should be removed (API violation) or an assertion should verify defensive behavior.
close_reason: Removed invalid NULL assertion on line 109 - lichen_hal_identity_get has _Nonnull parameter and void return type, so passing NULL is an API contract violation (undefined behavior)
